key_highlights: ASX posts fourth consecutive losing week as rising bond yields pressure equities
RBA signals continued rate hikes despite sharp unemployment jump, creating an interest-rate pincer for households
AUD experiences a 'trapdoor' decline amid US-China tensions and domestic data weakness
Australian house prices over halfway to largest 40-year correction; Victoria worst-hit
Small-cap mining active: $2.7B cap-raise wave, gold hits from Aurum, Zenith, Kuniko
Star's Sydney casino licence remains suspended, weighing on gaming sector
Data centre energy demand threatens grid capacity, creating an energy 'bust' risk

sectors.trend: Small-cap gold and base-metal explorers active with strong assay results (Aurum 155g/t, Zenith 6/6 hits in WA), but $2.7B cap-raise wave signals dilution risk. Large-caps (BHP, RIO, FMG) pressured by AUD weakness and China demand uncertainty post Xi-Trump meeting.
sectors.implications: Selective small-cap gold exposure attractive; large-cap miners face margin pressure from weaker AUD and softening iron ore demand signals.

sectors.trend: RBA hiking into a rising unemployment backdrop compresses NIM expectations while credit losses rise. Renters' financial stress (50%+ struggling) elevates mortgage default risk. Star casino licence suspension hits gaming-adjacent revenue.
sectors.implications: CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC face margin pressure; defensive positioning warranted. Gaming names (STAR) under regulatory overhang.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom straining grid capacity creates an 'energy bust' risk; power demand surge may force curtailment or price spikes. Energy transition investment under pressure.
sectors.implications: Energy producers (SME, WES, AGL) benefit from demand but face infrastructure constraints; utilities see tariff upside.

sectors.trend: House prices over halfway to 40-year correction; CBD commercial tower listed at $40m signals distress. Dusty Martin's $20m portfolio haircut reflects broader repricing. Renters' stress supports rental demand but caps yield expansion.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW, ICOL, DGL) under pressure; selective value in rental-focused trusts.

sectors.trend: Interest-rate pincer squeezing household budgets; consumer discretionary under pressure. Food and beverage innovation (Pickle Pepsis, Dragonberry) signals category evolution. Bentley EV at $325k tests premium auto demand.
sectors.implications: WES, WBC, CPL defensive; discretionary names (WOW, LNE) face headwinds.

sectors.trend: AI safety concerns post-Medicare breach; Pocock calls for AI safety act. US tech (Nvidia, AMD, Zscaler) active but ASX tech exposure limited. CSL remains key healthcare anchor.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX defensive; ASX tech names (W1, XRO) benefit from global AI capex but face regulatory uncertainty.

key_themes: RBA hiking into recession risk – policy dilemma
AUD weakness as a structural 'trapdoor' amid US-China friction
Property correction deepening across all major cities
Small-cap mining cap-raise dilution vs. exploration upside
Energy infrastructure strain from data centre demand
Household financial stress: renters, rate pincer, unemployment

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike into rising unemployment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (staples, healthcare); underweight growth equities and property.
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners (BHP, RIO) that benefit from weaker dollar.
Reduce REIT and property-linked exposure; monitor bank credit-loss provisions.
Shorten duration in fixed income; favour short-dated bonds; maintain cash buffer.
Diversify away from China-revenue-heavy miners; monitor iron ore and LNG pricing.
Avoid pre-announcement small-caps; favour funded explorers with limited dilution.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight large-cap miners benefiting from AUD weakness
opportunities.rationale: Weaker AUD boosts AUD-reported earnings for BHP, RIO, FMG; China demand stabilising post Xi-Trump meeting.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap gold exposure on strong assay results
opportunities.rationale: Aurum 155g/t, Zenith 6/6 WA hits signal resource upside; gold hedges rate uncertainty.
CSL and WES offer earnings visibility amid rate pincer and consumer stress.

defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year house price correction underway; CBD commercial distress; renter stress caps yields.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Shorten bond duration; favour 1-3yr government bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hiking cycle elevates yield volatility; long bonds at risk of further mark-to-market losses.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid gaming and discretionary consumer names
defensive_moves.rationale: Star licence suspension; rate pincer crushing discretionary spend.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to extend losses in 5th week as RBA hike, rising yields, and AUD weakness dominate. Bond-equity correlation negative. Small-caps volatile on cap-raise news. Expect ^AXJO to test support levels.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious: property correction and unemployment rising may force RBA pivot by Q1 2027, creating a late-cycle bottoming opportunity. Miners and exporters benefit from sustained AUD weakness. Energy infrastructure investment a structural tailwind.

Iron ore and LNG price direction
US AI regulation impact on global tech
